issues.title: Owner-composed household manipulation flagship
issues.description: Extend the existing Frankensim mathematical owners into a second flagship: a parametric home-scale KUKA/FANUC-style arm performs black-box pick-and-place of irregular household objects across kitchen, living-room, and backyard scenes. Reuse fs-ga SE(3)/Lie algebra, fs-mbd articulated dynamics and the existing KUKA catalog, fs-contact, fs-tribo, and the schema-2 scalable CMA family; do not create a parallel robot-math representation. First make one physically honest manipulation task excellent before multiplying scenes.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Owner-composed arm and gripper model with provenance; collision/contact receipts for at least three irregular objects; deterministic objective resistant to early-termination reward hacking; worker-based separable/LM-CMA/LM-MA optimization; owner-derived Three.js poses with an explicit display-only-vs-dynamic legend; tests proving every policy coordinate affects the task and optimized replay improves a fixed baseline; mobile/desktop smoke tests with zero page, console, or network errors.
